findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_whatsapp, verify_email, check_blacklist, check_spam_score, scrape_url, search_social, get_social_post, get_x_comments, google_serp · Private data: verify_email · Public sink: whatsapp_batch_submit, verify_email, check_spam_score, search_social, get_social_post, get_x_comments · Destructive: google_serp, run_brand_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_whatsapp, verify_email, check_blacklist, check_spam_score, scrape_url, search_social, get_social_post, get_x_comments, google_serp · Private data: verify_email · Public sink: whatsapp_batch_submit, verify_email, check_spam_score, search_social, get_social_post, get_x_comments · Destructive: google_serp, run_brand_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
